Former Army Chief General V.N. Sharma Passes Away in Himachal Pradesh

Former Army Chief General V.N. Sharma has passed away in Himachal Pradesh. He was the former Chief of Army Staff and hailed from Palampur. The coverage notes his passing as a loss to the region, referring to him as a 'glorious son' of the 'land of heroes'.
